newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers hold despite ARA barge gains.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers hold despite ARA barge gains.

text.p: ARA bunkers ended barely changed on Friday despite a $4 rise in barge prices, while bunkers in most other European ports were flat, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at around $100 fob by the close. Barges rose $4 a tonne to $100/$101 and initially led to bunker quotes of $102/$103 fob, but dealers said majors were able to undercut the quotes of independents and fulfil the limited demand.
"I think they (the sellers) don't believe in the strong market, so they are prepared to sell bunkers lower," one dealer said.
Hamburg bunkers were $1 a tonne lower than on Thursday, leaving them slightly below Rotterdam quotes. This advantage caused a notable rise in business.
Mediterranean prices were mostly steady, except in France where intense competition led to a $3 drop in fuel oil offers.
"They were crazy prices and competition for not that much demand," one French supplier said.
Egyptian prices rose as supply tightened. Alexandria was without product and deliveries in other ports were subject to enquiry, brokers said.
